mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals manufacturing sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO remains below 95.0 for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales growth above 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are supported.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent price pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as aggressive monetary tightening is anticipated.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession probability increases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines >0.5% and UNRATE rises >0.2pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS above 4.0%) reduce equity valuations through higher discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as policy shifts to restraint.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% for at least 3 consecutive months.
